tags.instructions: Use this when the caller wants Avoma to generate a fresh secret. Coordinate receiver changes before proceeding; this replaces the shared organization-wide value and no old-key grace period is guaranteed. Use `update-webhook-signing-secret` instead when rolling out a secret chosen in advance. Keep the returned secret secure. Do not automatically retry an uncertain rotation; inspect the current value with `get-webhook-signing-secret` first.

functions.description: Remove the organization's configured webhook signing secret. Outbound webhook deliveries continue without the X-Avoma-Signature header.

Use `get-webhook-signing-secret` first if a trusted operator needs to preserve the current value securely. Use `update-webhook-signing-secret` or `create-webhook-signing-secret` to configure signing again; the deleted value is not returned by this tool.

content.description: Parsed replacement Slate editor blocks, preserving nested content and metadata.

ownerEmail.description: Actual resulting owner email when returned.

FunctionOutput_avoma_updatetemplate.description: Updated meeting note template with parsed replacement editor content and resulting associations.

tags.instructions: Use `get-template` to inspect the template first and `list-smart-categories` and `list-meeting-types` to obtain all desired association IDs. This is replacement, not a patch: resupply the full desired category and meeting-type sets, privacy and default flag. Empty arrays remove those associations/content selections. Omitted ownerEmail delegates owner selection to Avoma and may reassign ownership to its oldest administrator; supply an organization owner email to control that choice.
